title: Spotify
description: Sign in with your Spotify account. Set your own Client ID only if Jellyfesh's Spotify app has no place for your account.

client_id.title: Your Own Client ID
client_id.description: Optional: the Client ID of your own Spotify app (32 letters and digits), with http://127.0.0.1:29817/callback as its Redirect URI. Leave empty to use Jellyfesh's.
